project.name: osgi/domains/auth/auth-port
project.description: The auth domain's seam: the AuthTokenContact verb (resolve a short-lived credential for one AuthTokenSource — GitHub or FloxHub — by asking its CLI) and the flat AuthTokenSource enum. The auth-edge satisfies it by shelling `gh auth token` / `flox auth token`; the host launch-secrets updater composes it, keeping the env-var precedence and the YAML upsert. type=seam: system-exported, one shared copy across the host↔bundle boundary, like every -port.
